contents.name: report_finding
contents.arguments: {"shipment_id": "SH-4471", "status": "cause_found", "cause": "The required commercial invoice (DOC-5531) was filed against cleared case RTM-88124 instead of this shipment's case RTM-88213, so RTM-88213 shows the document as not received and the shipment is held.", "evidence": [{"record_id": "RTM-88213", "fact": "Case RTM-88213 is on hold because a required document was not received, and lists the commercial invoice as not received."}, {"record_id": "DOC-5531", "fact": "The commercial invoice DOC-5531 was uploaded Thursday but filed against customs case RTM-88124."}, {"record_id": "RTM-88124", "fact": "Case RTM-88124 belongs to a different shipment (SH-4398) and is already cleared, so DOC-5531 does not belong there."}], "recommended_action": "Refile the commercial invoice DOC-5531 against RTM-88213 so the customs case shows all required documents received.", "refiling": {"document_id": "DOC-5531", "customs_case": "RTM-88213"}}
